semantic_insights: The complete unwrapped root record is the sole scoring unit; nested file-collection metadata is considered in place.
The DOI, root identifier, landing page, and publisher identify the same FAIRhub dataset.
Human-subject participation is supported by named ethics oversight and detailed consent documentation.
Primary NIH funding, grant details, and T2DM research purposes are aligned, with ancillary publication funding explicitly distinguished.
The license, verified-login access procedure, disease-specific use restriction, and distribution formats are mutually compatible.
The selected chronology places initial IRB approval before collection and the release after its collection interval.
Participant split counts and each reported demographic or diabetes-status distribution sum to 2280.
The nine data-directory file counts sum to 356334; adding the nine dataset-level metadata files reconciles the stated 356343 files.
Static published releases and an approximately annual cadence for new versions are compatible statements.
Standardized modality formats and the one-to-one OMOP table mapping provide concrete interoperability evidence.
